claims.text: The deviation is established on the governing field. POL-RD-01 requires the threshold test to run on gps_trace.trace_distance_km, which reads 18.2 km, against a booked optimal of 14.0 km carried on the trip record: an excess of 4.2 km, being 30.0% of optimal. Both limbs pass — the excess is greater than 20% of optimal and greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms — so a route deviation is ESTABLISHED. [Disclosure: EV-GPS-02850 is impaired — weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW.]

The trace figure governs, and the trip record's copy may not be used for the threshold. POL-RD-01 states that trip_record.actual_distance_km is a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement and 'may NOT be cited for the threshold test'. Here the two agree at 18.2 km, so nothing turns on the choice, but the citation must be the trace. [Disclosure: EV-GPS-02850 is impaired — weight 0.6, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW.]

The trace is impaired at policy level as well as at schema level, and the rider says so. The 100.0 s gap from 22:07:31 to 22:09:11 exceeds the 90-second limit in POL-RD-07(a), so POL-RD-07 is engaged; limb (i) then directs that excess distance across the impaired stretch be read as the straight line between the bounding fixes — 1.0 km — which is the reading most favourable to the driver, and the rider accepts that reading. [Disclosure: EV-GPS-02850 is impaired — weight 0.6, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW.]

The gap does not disturb the establishment finding. Even if the entire impaired stretch were struck out, so that the whole 1.0 km straight-line hop were treated as bare excess rather than as distance driven, the excess would still be 3.2 km on an optimal of 14.0 km — 22.9% — and would still pass both POL-RD-01 thresholds. The impairment narrows the margin; it does not remove the deviation. [Disclosure: EV-GPS-02850 is impaired — weight 0.6, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW.]

Because the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a), POL-RD-07(ii) requires the deviation to be carried by an independent source, and one exists on this record: the driver's own counterparty_statement, 'Navigation rerouted me.' That is a counterparty_statement admitting the route — the driver does not deny that the vehicle travelled a route other than the booked optimal; he supplies a cause for having done so. POL-RD-07(ii) names that source expressly, and the admission supplies precisely what the gap removed. [Disclosure: EV-GPS-02850 is impaired — weight 0.6, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW.]

No traffic advisory covers this trip. EV-ADVIS-02850-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and its own notes record that no advisory covers the Tampines Mall corridor in this window. POL-RD-03 requires an advisory that names a road or segment the optimal route traverses, carries a validity window overlapping the time the trace shows the vehicle would have reached that segment, and is matched by a route that leaves the corridor before and rejoins it after. With the artifact absent and weightless that comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and 'Navigation rerouted me' — which is not an advisory — exonerates nothing. [Disclosure: EV-ADVIS-02850-01 is MISSING — weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT.]

The absent advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it, and it does not escalate the case out of a monetary ruling. The driver names no evidence ID for any advisory, so under POL-RD-13 an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged. The consequence is the one POL-RD-13(2) states: where the rider has shown an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold on a trace corroborated under POL-RD-07(ii), the deviation stands at the measured figure, POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal, and the ruling records that the traffic assertion was discarded and that no advisory was on file. [Disclosure: EV-ADVIS-02850-01 is MISSING — weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT.]

POL-RD-04 cannot excuse any part of the excess. The chat log EV-CHAT-02850 holds 0 messages, with first_message_at and last_message_at both null: there is no rider instruction, no waypoint_hint and no named road, so the clause's (a) to (c) conditions cannot be met and the corroboration test cannot be run at all. POL-RD-14 makes the same point from the other side — with no instruction found in the log there is nothing to corroborate and no distance to exclude.

POL-RD-05 does not apply. pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null on the trip record, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are both null with them, so no amended endpoint and no amended re-quote exist. There is no stored figure against which POL-RD-01 could be re-run, and the baseline remains the booked 14.0 km.

POL-RD-12 does not apply. The vehicle type on the trip record is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null; the matched-itinerary baseline this clause substitutes never arises, and no co-rider collection or set-down distance falls to be excluded from the excess.

POL-RD-11 does not close the distance-refund route. The fare breakdown records fare_model METERED and quoted_fare_sgd null, so the distance and time charges were not fixed at booking, the rider has not already been made whole on those lines, and POL-RD-02 runs in the ordinary way rather than the refund being limited to pass-through corrections.

The POL-RD-08 burden is discharged and shifts. The trip identifiers match across the bundle — TRP-02850 on the trip record, the trace and the fare ledger — and the trip start at 2026-09-07T21:58:31 is common to the trip record and the trace; the excess meets POL-RD-01. The burden then moves to the driver, who must point to a specific artifact and a specific clause to invoke POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05, POL-RD-11 or POL-RD-12. He points to none, and a bare assertion that traffic was bad, unsupported by a traffic_advisory ID, does not discharge it. [Disclosure: EV-GPS-02850 is impaired — weight 0.6, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW.]

No additional corroboration is demanded of this rider. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the POL-RD-08 add-on that requires corroboration beyond the trace for a claimant with 4 or more claims and 1 or fewer substantiated is not engaged. The claim stands on the ordinary burden, which is met, and the profile is used only for the test POL-RD-08 names, as POL-GEN-01 requires.

The refund is arithmetic, not discretionary. Under POL-RD-02, recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 19.0) x 1.0, the surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP on the optimal route = 20.42. Refund = charged_total 26.73 - 20.42 = 6.31, and the payable figure rounds UP to SGD 6.35. That clears the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and is far short of 90% of charged_total, so the ruling is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 6.35 — which is the figure the policy yields, and the rider asks for that figure rather than a round-number payment.

Nothing is to be added on top of that figure. erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp is 0.00 and airport_surcharge is 0.00, and POL-RD-09(1) already comprehends every pass-through line inside the recomputed fare. No separate ERP correction is due either way, and the refund is not to be doubled by adding one.

The impairment does not cap the ruling out of existence. POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the maximum weight_multiplier among the artifacts carrying the deciding fact where two or more independent artifacts carry it. The excess is the difference between the trace distance and the optimal distance on the trip record, and the optimal 14.0 km is carried by a clean weight-1.0 artifact that owes nothing to the trace. On the clause's own words the cap is therefore 1.0, not 0.6, and the POL-GEN-02(2) route to the POL-RD-10(1) escalation floor is not reached. [Disclosure: EV-GPS-02850 is impaired — weight 0.6, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW.]

No POL-RD-10 trigger fires and a ruling is available on this record. The trip identifiers match, the timestamps run forward, the refund of 6.35 is far below both the SGD 150.00 ceiling and charged_total, no exculpatory clause has been invoked against a cited artifact because the driver cites no advisory at all, and every charge line — base fare, distance, time and platform fee — is accounted for by the metered model with no ERP or surcharge line left unmatched.

The rider does not ask for a POL-RD-06 uplift, and should not be understood to. The excess here is 4.2 km and 30%, short of the 50% or 8.0 km materiality gate, and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 417 — 0 is neither 3 or more nor 0.05 or more — so no repeat pattern is established and no FULL_REFUND uplift or conduct referral follows from the profile. The remedy rests on the POL-RD-02 arithmetic alone, and the profile is cited only for the test POL-RD-06 names.

In the alternative, if the judge concludes that the driver's statement is not a route admission and that no independent corroboration exists, the outcome is not NO_ACTION. POL-RD-07(iii) directs that where corroboration is absent the claim is not sustained on the present record and the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION, because the absence of proof is a data failure and not a finding for the driver, and POL-RD-10(3) says the same. Under POL-GEN-03 an escalation is terminal and holds the disputed amount rather than collecting it, which is what the rider asks for on that branch. [Disclosure: EV-GPS-02850 is impaired — weight 0.6, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW; EV-ADVIS-02850-01 is MISSING — weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT.]

EV-GPS-02850 is impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a): the trace carries a 100.0-second gap between consecutive fixes, from 22:07:31 to 22:09:11, over a straight-line distance of 1.0 km — longer than the 90-second limit that limb sets. The admissibility pre-pass reaches the same view, tagging the artifact IMPAIRED on issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW at weight_multiplier 0.6, and POL-GEN-02(1) obliges me to disclose that discount in the same claim rather than present the trace as clean.

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and must show an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold 'measured from an unimpaired gps_trace or, where the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c), from an independent source named in POL-RD-07(ii)'. The trace is impaired under limb (a), so the first route is closed; the second requires a source from POL-RD-07(ii)'s closed list, and no such source exists on this record. The rider's burden is therefore not discharged.

POL-RD-07(ii) permits corroboration by 'a driver admission in the chat_log', and there is none: EV-CHAT-02850 records 0 messages, an empty message array and first_message_at and last_message_at both null. Across the whole trip the platform captured no communication in which the driver admitted a route.

The second independent source POL-RD-07(ii) names — 'the set of erp_gantries actually charged in the fare_breakdown placing the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use' — is also empty. EV-FARE-02850 charges no gantries at all: erp_gantries is an empty array, tolls_erp is 0.0, and the derived erp_lines block reports both on-optimal-route and off-optimal-route totals at 0.00. Nothing on the fare side places the vehicle on any corridor.

The billed distance cannot serve either. EV-FARE-02850 charges 18.2 km against a trace of 18.2 km, and POL-RD-07(ii) states in terms that the billed distance on the fare_breakdown is NOT independent corroboration where it is a copy of the trace figure. It is a copy here, and POL-RD-01 confirms why: trip_record.actual_distance_km is 'a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement' and may not be cited for the threshold test. The only remaining listed source, an independently derived trip_record.actual_distance_km, therefore does not exist.

The driver's filed statement, 'Navigation rerouted me.', does not fill the gap. POL-RD-07(ii) requires a counterparty_statement 'admitting the route' — that is, one that corroborates the corridor actually driven and the distance measured. This statement names no road, no corridor and no distance; it asserts a cause for a reroute without identifying what route was taken or that 18.2 km was driven. Read at its highest it is a bare causation assertion, and POL-RD-08 provides that such an assertion, unsupported by an advisory or comparable record, discharges nothing.

Nothing in the driver's profile can be turned against him. The measured excess of 4.2 km / 30% clears POL-RD-01's establishment gate but falls below its materiality gate (50% or 8.0 km absolute), so POL-RD-06 requires only the profile consultation; and that consultation returns nothing against the driver, because deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 417 — a ratio of 0.0, far under the 0.05 threshold at which a pattern would be established. No FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral follow, and POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (which reads 1) for the trailing-90-day field the clause actually names.

Honest concession on the driver's own explanation, and I do not rest the case on it: no traffic advisory covers this trip. EV-ADVIS-02850-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and no payload, its issue being MISSING_ARTIFACT for the Tampines Mall corridor. POL-RD-03 cannot be run against an advisory that does not exist, so 'Navigation rerouted me' is untestable on this record and exonerates nothing. The driver's case rests on the impairment of the trace, not on the traffic excuse.

The outcome the record supports is therefore ESCALATE, and not a refund. POL-RD-07(iii) directs that where an impaired trace leaves the excess uncorroborated, the claim is not sustained on the present record and the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION, because the absence of proof is a data failure and must not be converted into a finding for the driver; and POL-RD-10(3) makes that escalation mandatory where the trace is impaired under limbs (a) to (c) and no POL-RD-07(ii) corroborating artifact exists. On an escalation the disputed SGD 9.50 is held, not collected from the driver and not refunded to the rider.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver: this case goes to a human reviewer. No money is refunded and no money is collected today — the disputed SGD 9.50 is held until that review finishes (POL-GEN-03: an escalation is terminal and replaces the ruling).

WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. The trip record EV-TRIP-02850 puts the booked optimal distance at 14.0 km. The GPS trace EV-GPS-02850 puts the distance driven at 18.2 km — an excess of 4.2 km, or 30.0% of optimal. That clears POL-RD-01's two establishment gates (over 20% and over 0.8 km), so on the figures a deviation is established. But the trace is impaired: it carries a 100-second gap between fixes, from 22:07:31 to 22:09:11, longer than the 90-second limit in POL-RD-07(a). The admissibility pre-pass tagged EV-GPS-02850 IMPAIRED on issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW at weight_multiplier 0.60, and both advocates disclosed that discount.

WHY I CANNOT RULE ON THE MONEY. POL-GEN-02(2) caps my confidence at the weight of the artifact that carries the deciding fact. The fact that the vehicle drove 18.2 km is carried by the impaired trace alone. trip_record.actual_distance_km is, in POL-RD-01's own words, a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement and may not be used for the threshold test; and the fare ledger's 18.2 km (EV-FARE-02850) is a copy of the trace figure, which POL-RD-07(ii) states is not independent corroboration. No second, independent artifact carries that distance, so the cap is 0.60, not 1.00. The rider's argument that the clean 14.0 km optimal (EV-TRIP-02850, weight 1.0) lifts the cap to 1.00 is rejected: the excess needs the driven distance as well as the optimal, and only the impaired trace supplies the driven distance. A cap of 0.60 is below the platform's 0.70 confidence floor, so POL-RD-10(1) applies and the outcome is ESCALATE.

THE CORROBORATION QUESTION. POL-RD-07(ii) would let the impaired trace be carried by an independent source. There is no driver admission in the chat log (EV-CHAT-02850 holds 0 messages, first and last message times null), and no charged gantry placing the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use (EV-FARE-02850 charges no gantry; tolls_erp 0.00). The driver's statement, 'Navigation rerouted me.', concedes at most that a reroute occurred; it names no road, corridor or distance, and it cannot stand in for the traffic advisory that does not exist, so under POL-RD-08 it discharges nothing and under POL-RD-13 it exonerates nothing. I have also read it at its highest for the rider, as a counterparty statement admitting the route — and the case still escalates, because that statement is not an instrument artifact carrying a weight_multiplier, so it cannot lift the 0.60 cap, and POL-RD-10(1) still fires. On the other reading there is no POL-RD-07(ii) corroboration at all, and POL-RD-10(3) escalates directly. Either way the result is the same, and the rider's own alternative claim (that absent corroboration the outcome is ESCALATE, not NO_ACTION) is consequently accepted.

WHAT I DID NOT DO. No traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02850-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT. The driver cited no advisory identifier, so the absence is a gap in the bundle and not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation, and POL-RD-13 confirms that reading. The rider's claims that POL-RD-03 is unavailable and that the traffic assertion is weightless are accepted. POL-RD-04 does not run: EV-CHAT-02850 holds no rider instruction and no waypoint_hint. POL-RD-05 does not run: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null. POL-RD-12 does not run: the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL. POL-RD-11 does not run: fare_model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null. POL-RD-09 adds nothing to any figure: no ERP, no tolls and no surcharge (all 0.00). POL-RD-06 produces nothing against the driver — deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 417 completed trips, so no pattern is established, no FULL_REFUND uplift follows, and no conduct referral is licensed; POL-GEN-01 also barred the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags from that test. POL-RD-09(4) billing integrity is not engaged. The rider's claim that no POL-RD-10 trigger would fire is rejected for the reason given above; the referrals list is empty because no clause produces a referral on these facts.

THE ARITHMETIC, FOR THE REVIEWER. Had the case been decidable, POL-RD-02 would give: charged_total 26.73; recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 19.0) x 1.0, the surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, + 0.80 platform fee = 20.42; refund = 26.73 - 20.42 = 6.31, rounded up to SGD 6.35 — a PARTIAL_REFUND above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and well under 90% of charged_total. That figure, rider, is the figure your own claim computed and it is arithmetically right; it simply cannot issue while the confidence is capped at 0.60. The monetary effect (SGD 6.35) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, but that is academic on a terminal escalation.

WHAT WOULD RESOLVE IT. What the record needs is a clean GPS export that fills or corrects the 22:07:31-22:09:11 gap, a driver admission in the chat log, or a traffic advisory covering the trip window. Any of those would let the case be decided on the money rather than sent for review.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties — this dispute over SGD 9.50 is escalated to a human reviewer. No money moves: the amount is held, not refunded to the rider and not released to the driver.

The measurement itself is not in dispute. GPS trace EV-GPS-02850 records 18.2 km against the booked optimal of 14.0 km on EV-TRIP-02850 — an excess of 4.2 km, or 30.0% — which passes both of POL-RD-01's establishment tests. On a sound trace POL-RD-02 would recompute the fare to SGD 20.42 (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 19.0, surge multiplier 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, plus the 0.80 platform fee, no ERP on the optimal route) and yield a refund of SGD 6.35 (26.73 - 20.42 = 6.31, rounded up to the nearest 0.05). The rider's arithmetic is right on that footing, but the footing is not sound.

EV-GPS-02850 is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW — a 100.0 s gap between consecutive fixes (22:07:31 to 22:09:11) across 1.0 km — which exceeds the 90 s limit in POL-RD-07(a), so the trace is impaired for policy purposes and not merely at the schema pre-pass (POL-GEN-02(3)). The excess that decides this case is carried by that trace and by nothing independent: the 18.2 km on the trip record and on the fare ledger is a copy of the same measurement and is not independent corroboration (POL-RD-01; POL-RD-07(ii)). Under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence is capped at the minimum weight_multiplier among the artifacts carrying the deciding fact — 0.6 — which is below the 0.70 platform floor, and POL-RD-10(1) therefore requires ESCALATE. The rider's submission that the cap is 1.0 because the optimal 14.0 km sits on a clean artifact is rejected: the 'two or more independent artifacts' maximum applies only where they carry the same fact, and the optimal distance and the distance driven are different facts.

The driver's statement 'Navigation rerouted me' does not rescue a monetary ruling. It is a bare assertion of cause: it names no road, corridor or distance, and no traffic advisory covers this trip (EV-ADVIS-02850-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0), so under POL-RD-03 and POL-RD-13 it exonerates nothing and supplies no amended optimal. Even read at its highest — as the rider reads it, a counterparty statement admitting the route under POL-RD-07(ii) — it can corroborate the deviation but cannot lift the confidence cap, because a counterparty statement carries no weight_multiplier and enters neither the minimum nor the maximum of that cap. If instead it is not such an admission, POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) independently require ESCALATE. The outcome is the same on either reading, and NO_ACTION is not available: on an impaired trace, absence of proof is a data failure and not a finding for the driver (POL-RD-07(iii)).

Claims that do not change the result: the chat log EV-CHAT-02850 is empty, so no rider instruction excludes any distance (POL-RD-04, POL-RD-14); no pickup or dropoff was amended (POL-RD-05); the trip is RYDE_X, not pooled (POL-RD-12); the fare is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not close the distance route; there is no repeat-deviation pattern — driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 417 completed trips in 90 days — so no POL-RD-06 uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral; and no billing-integrity defect exists, no gantry and no surcharge line being charged, so POL-RD-09(4) is not engaged.

What would resolve it: a corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names and carrying its own weight — a chat-log admission, charged ERP gantries placing the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use, or a trip_record.actual_distance_km derived independently of this trace — or a repaired trace closing the 100 s gap. The reviewer may also weigh the counterparty statement directly.

To the rider and the driver: this dispute cannot be decided on the present record and is escalated to a human reviewer. No money moves on this ruling — the SGD 9.50 in dispute is held rather than collected or refunded (POL-GEN-03; POL-RD-10).

The measured facts. Trip TRP-02850 (vehicle RYDE_X, fare model METERED) ran 18.2 km against a booked optimal of 14.0 km — an excess of 4.2 km, 30.0% (EV-GPS-02850; EV-TRIP-02850). That clears both POL-RD-01 gates (over 20% and over 0.8 km), but nothing can be built on it, because the instrument that carries it is impaired.

Why we cannot rule. EV-GPS-02850 contains a 100.0-second gap between fixes (22:07:31 to 22:09:11), above the 90-second limit in POL-RD-07(a), and the pre-pass tags it IMPAIRED with issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW at weight_multiplier 0.6. Under POL-RD-07(ii) a deviation may not be established on an impaired trace alone; it must be corroborated by an independent source from that clause's list, and none exists here: EV-CHAT-02850 holds 0 messages (no driver admission); EV-FARE-02850 charges no ERP gantry and no surcharge, so nothing places the car on a corridor the optimal route does not use; and the billed 18.2 km is a copy of the trace figure. POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) therefore require escalation rather than NO_ACTION: with an impaired trace the absence of proof is a data failure, not a finding for the driver.

The driver's statement. 'Navigation rerouted me' does not fill that gap. It names no road, corridor or distance, so it does not 'admit the route' as POL-RD-07(ii) requires; it is a bare assertion of cause. Under POL-RD-08 an assertion citing no artifact carries no weight, and under POL-RD-13 the claim is tested against the traffic advisory for this trip and nothing else — EV-ADVIS-02850-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0, so POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the excuse is discarded. Because the driver named no advisory identifier, the missing advisory is not a POL-RD-10(5) trigger (POL-RD-13(1)); the escalation rests on POL-RD-07/POL-RD-10(3), which POL-RD-13 expressly leaves untouched where the trace itself is impaired.

Confidence. Independently, the deciding fact — the measured deviation — is carried by the impaired trace at weight 0.6. The trip record's actual_distance_km is a rounded copy of the same measurement and may not be cited for the threshold (POL-RD-01), and the fare breakdown's billed distance is a copy of the trace figure (POL-RD-07(ii)), so neither is an independent second carrier; the trip record's 14.0 km optimal is the baseline, not a second carrier of the deviation. The POL-GEN-02(2) cap is therefore 0.6, below the 0.70 confidence_floor the policy carries, and POL-RD-10(1) is engaged as well.

What we accepted. The trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown and the timestamps run forward. There was no chat instruction (POL-RD-04 unavailable, POL-RD-14 not reached), no amended endpoint or stored re-quote (POL-RD-05), no pooled itinerary (POL-RD-12), and the fare is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11 does not close the distance route — POL-RD-02 would run if the deviation stood: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75×14.0 + 0.28×19.0)×1.0 + 0.80 = 20.42, giving 26.73 − 20.42 = 6.31, rounded up to 6.35, above the 0.50 de minimis and short of the 90% full-refund share. No ERP, toll or surcharge line is unmatched (POL-RD-09), and the driver's profile shows deviation_flags_90d 0 against completed_trips_90d 417, so no repeat pattern is established under POL-RD-06 and no uplift or conduct referral follows (prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter and is not the field that clause names). The rider's alternative submission — that absent corroboration the case escalates rather than closes as NO_ACTION — is the branch we adopt.

To resolve it, the reviewer needs an independent record placing the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use (an ERP gantry record, a chat exchange, or a platform-derived distance independent of this trace), or an explanation of the 100-second gap that the trace itself does not supply.

ruling.explanation: To both parties: an automated ruling cannot be issued on this record, so the case goes to a human reviewer. No refund or compensation is paid now, and the disputed SGD 9.50 is held rather than collected or refunded. On the figures: the metered fare ledger EV-FARE-02850 charges SGD 26.73 and records 18.2 km driven against the booked optimal of 14.0 km on the trip record EV-TRIP-02850 — an excess of 4.2 km, or 30.0%. That is over both POL-RD-01 establishment tests (above 20% and above 0.8 km) but under its materiality tests (50% or 8.0 km). The rider's POL-RD-02 arithmetic is correct on those numbers: ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 19.0) x 1.0 surge read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee = 20.42; 26.73 - 20.42 = 6.31, rounded up to SGD 6.35, above the SGD 0.50 de minimis. That figure cannot issue, for the reasons below. The trace is the only measurement of the distance actually driven, and it is impaired at both levels, which must be said separately. At schema level EV-GPS-02850 carries issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW at weight_multiplier 0.6 — a 100.0-second gap from 22:07:31 to 22:09:11 covering a 1.0 km straight-line hop. At policy level it meets POL-RD-07(a): the 100.0-second gap exceeds that limb's 90-second limit. Under POL-RD-07 a deviation may not be established on an impaired trace alone; it must be corroborated from the closed list in POL-RD-07(ii). None is present. The chat log EV-CHAT-02850 is empty (0 messages), so there is no driver admission in chat. EV-FARE-02850 charges no gantries (erp_gantries empty, tolls_erp 0.00), so nothing places the vehicle on an off-optimal corridor. And trip_record.actual_distance_km is 18.2 km, a copy of the same trace measurement rather than an independently derived figure, so POL-RD-01 forbids citing it for the threshold and POL-RD-07(ii) refuses it as corroboration. The single candidate, the driver's filed statement 'Navigation rerouted me.', is a counterparty statement, but POL-RD-07(ii) requires one admitting the route: this text names no road, corridor or distance and so does not corroborate the corridor driven. Read instead as a traffic excuse it is equally weightless — the only advisory, EV-ADVIS-02850-01, is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-RD-03 cannot run and POL-RD-13 gives the assertion no weight. The rider is right that a missing, uncited advisory is a gap in the bundle and not the POL-RD-10(5) contradiction, but POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) nonetheless direct ESCALATE rather than dismissal on an impaired trace with no independent corroboration. On confidence, the rider's argument that POL-GEN-02(2) lifts the cap to 1.0 is rejected: the deciding fact is the 4.2 km excess, measured from the trace (0.6) against the booked optimal (1.0), and the optimal is a component of that fact, not a second independent artifact carrying the same fact — the other distance figures are copies of the one trace measurement. The cap is therefore the minimum, 0.6, below the 0.70 floor this policy sets, so POL-RD-10(1) directs escalation on that ground as well. Both grounds rest on EV-GPS-02850, and the finding does not survive the discount, because the trace is the only measurement of the distance driven. The remaining routes were checked. POL-RD-04 and POL-RD-14 do not apply: the chat log holds no message, so there is no rider instruction and nothing to corroborate. POL-RD-05 does not apply: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null, and the amended optimal figures are null with them. POL-RD-12 does not apply: the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL. POL-RD-11 does not apply: the fare model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-02 would ordinarily run. POL-RD-09 adds nothing: no ERP, toll or surcharge line exists, so there is no standalone pass-through correction and no billing-integrity referral under POL-RD-09(4). POL-RD-06 was consulted and returns nothing: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 417 completed trips in 90 days, so no repeat pattern is established and neither the FULL_REFUND uplift nor the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral follows. POL-RD-08's additional-corroboration rule is not engaged (rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0), and no profile field outside the ones the clauses name was used. No clause produces a referral, so the referrals list is empty. What would decide this case is a record that fixes the distance driven independently of this trace — a platform-derived trip distance, a charged gantry line, an in-app or chat admission, or a clean re-export of the trace without the 100-second gap.

No POL-RD-10 trigger fires and a ruling is available on this record. The trip identifiers match, the timestamps run forward, the refund of 6.35 is far below both the SGD 150.00 ceiling and charged_total, no exculpatory clause has been invoked against a cited artifact because the driver cites no advisory at all, and every charge line — base fare, distance, time and platform fee — is accounted for by the metered model with no ERP or surcharge line left unmatched.

The rider does not ask for a POL-RD-06 uplift, and should not be understood to. The excess here is 4.2 km and 30%, short of the 50% or 8.0 km materiality gate, and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 417 — 0 is neither 3 or more nor 0.05 or more — so no repeat pattern is established and no FULL_REFUND uplift or conduct referral follows from the profile. The remedy rests on the POL-RD-02 arithmetic alone, and the profile is cited only for the test POL-RD-06 names.

In the alternative, if the judge concludes that the driver's statement is not a route admission and that no independent corroboration exists, the outcome is not NO_ACTION. POL-RD-07(iii) directs that where corroboration is absent the claim is not sustained on the present record and the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION, because the absence of proof is a data failure and not a finding for the driver, and POL-RD-10(3) says the same. Under POL-GEN-03 an escalation is terminal and holds the disputed amount rather than collecting it, which is what the rider asks for on that branch. EV-GPS-02850 is impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a): the trace carries a 100.0-second gap between consecutive fixes, from 22:07:31 to 22:09:11, over a straight-line distance of 1.0 km — longer than the 90-second limit that limb sets. The admissibility pre-pass reaches the same view, tagging the artifact IMPAIRED on issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW at weight_multiplier 0.6, and POL-GEN-02(1) obliges me to disclose that discount in the same claim rather than present the trace as clean.

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and must show an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold 'measured from an unimpaired gps_trace or, where the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c), from an independent source named in POL-RD-07(ii)'. The trace is impaired under limb (a), so the first route is closed; the second requires a source from POL-RD-07(ii)'s closed list, and no such source exists on this record. The rider's burden is therefore not discharged.

ledger.claim: POL-RD-07(ii) permits corroboration by 'a driver admission in the chat_log', and there is none: EV-CHAT-02850 records 0 messages, an empty message array and first_message_at and last_message_at both null. Across the whole trip the platform captured no communication in which the driver admitted a route.

The second independent source POL-RD-07(ii) names — 'the set of erp_gantries actually charged in the fare_breakdown placing the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use' — is also empty. EV-FARE-02850 charges no gantries at all: erp_gantries is an empty array, tolls_erp is 0.0, and the derived erp_lines block reports both on-optimal-route and off-optimal-route totals at 0.00. Nothing on the fare side places the vehicle on any corridor.

The billed distance cannot serve either. EV-FARE-02850 charges 18.2 km against a trace of 18.2 km, and POL-RD-07(ii) states in terms that the billed distance on the fare_breakdown is NOT independent corroboration where it is a copy of the trace figure. It is a copy here, and POL-RD-01 confirms why: trip_record.actual_distance_km is 'a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement' and may not be cited for the threshold test. The only remaining listed source, an independently derived trip_record.actual_distance_km, therefore does not exist.

ledger.claim: The driver's filed statement, 'Navigation rerouted me.', does not fill the gap. POL-RD-07(ii) requires a counterparty_statement 'admitting the route' — that is, one that corroborates the corridor actually driven and the distance measured. This statement names no road, no corridor and no distance; it asserts a cause for a reroute without identifying what route was taken or that 18.2 km was driven. Read at its highest it is a bare causation assertion, and POL-RD-08 provides that such an assertion, unsupported by an advisory or comparable record, discharges nothing.

Nothing in the driver's profile can be turned against him. The measured excess of 4.2 km / 30% clears POL-RD-01's establishment gate but falls below its materiality gate (50% or 8.0 km absolute), so POL-RD-06 requires only the profile consultation; and that consultation returns nothing against the driver, because deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 417 — a ratio of 0.0, far under the 0.05 threshold at which a pattern would be established. No FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral follow, and POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (which reads 1) for the trailing-90-day field the clause actually names.

ledger.claim: Honest concession on the driver's own explanation, and I do not rest the case on it: no traffic advisory covers this trip. EV-ADVIS-02850-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and no payload, its issue being MISSING_ARTIFACT for the Tampines Mall corridor. POL-RD-03 cannot be run against an advisory that does not exist, so 'Navigation rerouted me' is untestable on this record and exonerates nothing. The driver's case rests on the impairment of the trace, not on the traffic excuse.

The outcome the record supports is therefore ESCALATE, and not a refund. POL-RD-07(iii) directs that where an impaired trace leaves the excess uncorroborated, the claim is not sustained on the present record and the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION, because the absence of proof is a data failure and must not be converted into a finding for the driver; and POL-RD-10(3) makes that escalation mandatory where the trace is impaired under limbs (a) to (c) and no POL-RD-07(ii) corroborating artifact exists. On an escalation the disputed SGD 9.50 is held, not collected from the driver and not refunded to the rider.
